flow.disclaimer: Guessed from project links + whatever security signals I found — not an official sequence diagram from Abraxas.
flow.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant WebApp as Web app
  participant Svc as Domain service
  participant Basis as Basis
  participant SR as Stimmregister
  participant HSM as HSM PKCS11
  WebApp->>Svc: Load contest / context
  Svc->>Basis: Master data (contest, DoI, circles)
  Svc->>SR: Count of voters / register queries
  WebApp->>Svc: Submit / mutate state
  WebApp->>Svc: Second factor (OTP) on sensitive transition
  Svc->>HSM: Sign event (PKCS#11)
  Svc->>Svc: Append signed event
  Note over WebApp,Svc: Heuristic flow — verify against domain docs
